acceptance_criteria.requirement: Each of fn::mt109_has_grant, fn::mt109_has_workspace_access, fn::mt109_source_read, fn::mt120_document_access and fn::mt120_loom_block_access first resolves the protected_resources record by (resource_kind, external_resource_id) through protected_resources_external_unique (parent/grandparent via that record's links), then selects resource_grants with account_id, principal_id, access_space_id and resource_id = <resolved record> equality, so resource_grants_exact_idx serves all four fields. No resource_id.* link predicate remains in those resource_grants WHERE clauses.

Allow/deny semantics are identical for every existing condition: live session; session and principal delegated_capabilities ('*' or the capability); grant status active, revoked_at NONE, expiry; account/principal/access_space equality; resource lifecycle_state active, owner_account_id, access_space_id, created_by_principal_id.status enabled; resource policy_version <= grant policy_version <= $auth.policy_version where currently checked; resource_kind/external_resource_id; parent and grandparent chain conditions (mt109_source_read, mt120_document_access, mt120_loom_block_access); actions and capability_ids; delegation_chain equality; the reconciliation_queue service-identity special case; the memory.propose/memory.read delegation rule in mt109_source_read. A missing resource returns false without error. Function signatures, callers, table PERMISSIONS clauses and the record-user execution context are unchanged; no privileged/root path is introduced.

Existing authority and denial tests stay green on the candidate: every test in storage::surreal::resource_authority_tests, plus the union's existing core authority selections (schema catalog/pin/upgrade tests, schema::tests::document_grant_single_live_policy_witness_controls_record_user_visibility, api::loom::tests::mt153_loom_route_family_authority_matrix, mt154_non_loom_route_authority_tests, knowledge_fail_closed_tests, knowledge_documents_api_tests, loom_atomic_receipt_tests).

New focused core timing test storage::surreal::resource_authority_tests::grant_check_cost_is_independent_of_grant_count runs as record user on the existing embedded SurrealDB resource-authority harness. For N=50 and N=500 active grants held by the same principal on distinct protected resources, it times (i) one SELECT of a knowledge_idempotency_keys row by record id and (ii) one fn::mt120_document_access check; each metric is the median of 5 timed samples after 1 warm-up. It asserts median(N=500)/median(N=50) < 2.0 and every median < 250 ms, asserts every timed probe returned the authorized row/true (no vacuous timing) and a no-grant probe returns empty/false, prints the measured values, and removes everything it creates outside the artifact root (CX-GIT-003).

The schema catalog stays consistent: because the fn text is part of the pinned catalog, SCHEMA_REVISION advances with a predecessor-upgrade path following the existing revision-160/161 pattern in schema.rs (re-emit the changed DEFINE FUNCTION statements, record the predecessor pins, update GENERATED/INFO pins). A revision-161 store upgrades in place; existing pin/upgrade tests change only as the bump requires and pass.
No SQLite/PostgreSQL connectivity, fallback, cache or fixture path is introduced (CX-503R); the proof uses the Handshake-managed embedded SurrealDB harness only.
